description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Bighorner Rancher.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat.
